has place name

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasPlaceName
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPlaceName
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/names

Relates a geographic gmeow:Place to a structured gmeow:PlaceName (toponym) it bears; the place-scoped specialization of gmeow:hasAppellation, mirroring gmeow:hasName for persons. Non-functional — a place bears many co-equal names (endonym/exonym, multilingual, historical); none is primary, and superseded ones set gmeow:displayable false. The structured, first-class replacement for the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Place -> gmeow:PlaceName Sub-property of: gmeow:hasAppellation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasPlaceName from gmeow:Place to gmeow:PlaceName when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasAppellation, gmeow:Place, gmeow:PlaceName
